annotations.title: Check: price, networks and fee wallets

description: The paid Check of any wallet: price { maximum (dollars, one system variable, 1.99), perNetwork (the maximum divided by 6, down to the cent: 0.33), amount (= maximum, for older clients), currency }; the price of a Check is perNetwork times the networks chosen, never above maximum. checkNetworks [{ chainId, family }] (the seven to choose: 1, 10, 56, 137, 8453, 42161, solana-mainnet), networks [{ chainId, family, token (the USDC that pays), feeWallet }] (where it is paid: the nine EVM networks and solana-mainnet), creditLimit and chargeValidSeconds (1800). Public, no proof needed.
name: check_info
